title: PhoneAgent — live catalog of rentable SMS phone numbers for AI agents. Returns 7
description: PhoneAgent — live catalog of rentable SMS phone numbers for AI agents. Returns 70+ supported countries (UK, US, Indonesia, India, Germany, Brazil, +) with per-service availability for Telegram, WhatsApp, Google, Facebook, Instagram, Twitter/X, Discord, Microsoft, Apple, PayPal, ChatGPT, plus `other` for any platform not listed. Each entry shows pricing tier ($1, $2, or $5 USDC), inventory pool size, and service name. Refreshed every 5 minutes from upstream wholesale. Pair with POST /rent to rent a number — charged only when an SMS arrives. Upstream SMS deliverability is non-deterministic (typical ~30-50% per attempt depending on country, service, and pool freshness); plan to retry — failed rentals expire silently with no on-chain settle. No signup, no API keys, machine-to-machine.
